moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this weekend, with matches scheduled from Friday, August 21st to Monday, August 24th.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: It's BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off today, bringing top-flight football back to our screens. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Big Match Focus
angles.copy: Huge weekend of football ahead! Arsenal face Coventry tonight, Hull host Man Utd tomorrow, and Sunday sees Man City vs Bournemouth and Newcastle vs Liverpool. What's your must-watch game?

angles.name: Local Team Shoutout
angles.copy: Your team is back in action! The Premier League season is officially underway. Get ready for all the drama, goals, and glory.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz, club culture, soul, and electronic music, concludes this weekend in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, having run from August 20th-23rd.

source.l: We Out Here Festival Official Site
